text:
Predicates:
RealName(x, y) ::: x's real name is y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
RealName(ailton, "Ailton Silva") ∧ Born(ailton, 1995) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ LoanedTo(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ Brazilian(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
SameClub(nautico, braga) ∧ FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga. Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailton, footballClub) ::: Ailton Silva does not play for a football club.
